confidence_legend.medium: Direct user-authored statement with limited corroboration, or strong transactional inference.
confidence_legend.low: Weak inference retained only as a lead and not promoted to canonical profile.

Current user-stated facts override older email-derived evidence.
The May 2025 Audio Engineering master's statement is retained as medium confidence because it is direct self-report but not independently corroborated by program/provider mail in this archive.
